1.web: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
1.asv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.

2.web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
2.asv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

3.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
3.asv: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.

4.web: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
4.asv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts; His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.

5.web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
5.asv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.

6.web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
6.asv: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a parched land.

7.web: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
7.asv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; [Selah

8.web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
8.asv: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God: Yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

9.web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.
9.asv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

10.web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
10.asv: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.

11.web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
11.asv: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.

12.web: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
12.asv: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

13.web: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
13.asv: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, It is asthe wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.

14.web: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
14.asv: When the Almighty scattered kings therein, It was as whenit snoweth in Zalmon.

15.web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
15.asv: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.

16.web: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
16.asv: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains, At the mountain which God hath desired for his abode? Yea, Jehovah will dwell in it for ever.

17.web: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
17.asv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands upon thousands: The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the sanctuary.

18.web: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
18.asv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led away captives; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that Jehovah God might dwell with them.

19.web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
19.asv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. [Selah

20.web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
20.asv: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto Jehovah the Lord belongeth escape from death.

21.web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
21.asv: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.

22.web: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;
22.asv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bringthem again from the depths of the sea;

23.web: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
23.asv: That thou mayest crush them, dipping thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.

24.web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
24.asv: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

25.web: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,
25.asv: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, In the midst of the damsels playing with timbrels.

26.web: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
26.asv: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, ye that are of the fountain of Israel.

27.web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
27.asv: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah and their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

28.web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
28.asv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

29.web: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
29.asv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Kings shall bring presents unto thee.

30.web: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.
30.asv: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Trampling under foot the pieces of silver: He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war.

31.web: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
31.asv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall haste to stretch out her hands unto God.

32.web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.
32.asv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; Oh sing praises unto the Lord; [Selah

33.web: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
33.asv: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.

34.web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
34.asv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.

35.web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
35.asv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
